description: A script for manually canceling previous GitHub Action workflow runs in queue, with command-line options for targeting specific branches or pull requests.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the GitHub API with authorization headers.

methods.name: list_runs
methods.description: Lists all GitHub workflow runs, paginated.

methods.name: cancel_run
methods.description: Cancels a specific workflow run by ID.

methods.name: get_pull_request
methods.description: Retrieves pull request details from GitHub.

methods.name: get_runs
methods.description: Retrieves workflow runs associated with a branch or user, filtered by statuses and events.

methods.name: print_commit
methods.description: Prints commit message and details for verification.
